notes: Years refer to when each paper was sat. Autumn BMO 1 papers often have official filenames ending in the following year; BMO 2 is normally sat in January of that following year.
There are two BMO 1 sittings in calendar years 1987 and 2001, shown separately with their dates.
The first-round archive includes the original BMO before 1992. The second-round archive includes its predecessor FIST (1972–1991), whose format differs from modern BMO 2.

Official scans begin with BMO 1973 and FIST 1972. BMO 1965–1972 and FIST 1973 scans are not available in the official archive. There was no FIST paper in 1987. The 1965–1996 handbook provides additional early problems and some solutions as a paid book.
Written solutions and detailed markers’ reports are prioritised where published; official video solutions are also linked. Missing written solutions or historical award thresholds are left unfilled.
Medal thresholds are distinct from merit/distinction certificate thresholds. BMO 2 qualification can depend on school year and eligibility, so the figures alone do not guarantee entry.
